title: Both projective-line product projections and their canonical relative charts
statement: For a scheme $S$ in universe $u$, put $q:P=\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] and $W=P\times_SP$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Index the projections by $a\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and define $p_{\mathrm{false}}=\operatorname{pr}_1$ and $p_{\mathrm{true}}=\operatorname{pr}_2$. Define $e_a:\mathbf P^1_P\cong W$ to be the canonical isomorphism from the projective-space base-change Cartesian square for $q$, using its flipped square for $a=\mathrm{false}$ and its unflipped square for $a=\mathrm{true}$. Retain as part of the chart datum the structural equation $p_a\circ e_a=q_P:\mathbf P^1_P\to P$. There are no coefficient, Noetherianity, or invertibility assumptions.
